mapper.select: SELECT s.conversation_generation FROM sq_goal_task t JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = t.user_id AND s.scope_id = t.scope_id AND s.owner_id = t.task_id AND s.conversation_id = t.conversation_id AND s.kind = 'TASK' WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.task_id = #{taskId} AND t.del_flag = '0' AND s.del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.task_id, t.origin_message_id AS source_message_id, t.status, t.version, t.goal_revision FROM sq_goal_task t JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = t.user_id AND s.scope_id = t.scope_id JOIN sq_message m ON m.user_id = t.user_id AND m.message_id = t.origin_message_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND s.conversation_generation = #{generation} AND m.message_seq <= #{through} AND t.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 5 FOR UPDATE

SELECT f.category, f.actor, f.safe_message, m.message_id AS source_message_id, CASE WHEN s.kind = 'TASK' THEN s.owner_id ELSE NULL END AS task_id FROM sq_execution_failure f JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = f.user_id AND s.scope_id = f.scope_id LEFT JOIN sq_response_execution r ON r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.execution_id = s.owner_id AND s.kind = 'RESPONSE' LEFT JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.task_id = s.owner_id AND s.kind = 'TASK' JOIN sq_message m ON m.user_id = s.user_id AND m.message_id = COALESCE(r.source_message_id, t.origin_message_id) WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND s.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND s.conversation_generation = #{generation} AND m.message_seq <= #{through} AND f.status <> 'RESOLVED' AND f.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT 10 FOR UPDATE
